description: This file defines the LoanSecurityShortfall class and functions for managing loan security shortfalls, including updating status, adding security, checking for LTV shortfalls, creating shortfall records, and retrieving LTV ratios within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanSecurityShortfall
classes.description: Represents a record of a loan security shortfall, inheriting from Document.

methods.name: update_shortfall_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a loan security shortfall based on security value.

methods.name: add_security
methods.description: Creates a new loan security pledge document for a given loan.

methods.name: check_for_ltv_shortfall
methods.description: Checks for loan-to-value shortfalls across loans and creates shortfall records if needed.

methods.name: create_loan_security_shortfall
methods.description: Creates or updates a loan security shortfall record with details.

methods.name: get_ltv_ratio
methods.description: Retrieves the loan-to-value ratio for a given security.

methods.name: update_pending_shortfall
methods.description: Marks a pending shortfall as completed.
